Dead-Wave

Choose how you survive the outbreak. You start with a pistol, a knife and $40. Kills drop cash; the supply hatch in the east wall of your cabin sells everything else — guns, ammo, gear, upgrades, blueprints. Walk up to it and press E; time stops while you shop.

Tips

Movement & looking

  • WASD / arrows — move: W is up the screen, whichever way you're aiming · Shift — run
  • Space — jump · V — dodge roll (can't be hurt mid-roll)
  • C — crouch: slower, but tighter groups and a lower silhouette
  • Mouse — aim anywhere around you; the marine turns to face the reticle while the camera holds still, so shots land where it sits
  • Scroll wheel — zoom the camera in / out (scoped, it dials the magnification)
  • Hold the middle mouse button and drag — rotate the camera
  • The tilt looks after itself: the view lifts to look up a hill ahead, drops into a dip, and rises over ground behind you instead of crowding the marine
  • The camera slides toward the cursor once you point past the middle of the screen, so you see more of what you're aiming at
  • Esc > Settings > Camera turns both off (with auto tilt off, middle-drag up / down tilts by hand again). Look sensitivity is there too

Combat

  • LMB — fire / hold for the chainsaw and flamethrower · R — reload
  • RMB — zoom. On the sniper it raises a real scope on whatever the reticle is on; the mouse then moves the scope directly (push to the screen edge to swing further). Wheel or middle click — 2X / 4X / 6X
  • G — grenade · F — knife (or the machete, once bought)
  • H — use a medkit. Health only regenerates back to 40% on its own
  • Hold Q — weapon wheel: time slows, point at a gun, let go to draw it · tap Q to step to the next one

Action key (E)

  • E at the kiosk (the supply hatch in the east wall of the cabin, yellow square on the map) — weapons, ammo, gear, upgrades, perks, blueprints. Open any time; time stops while you shop. E or Esc closes it
  • E at a mortar — man it: LMB lobs a shell at the reticle (dotted arc), E leaves it, T shoulders it to carry it (no weapons while carrying; LMB or E sets it down)

Building

  • Hold B — build wheel: point at a build, let go to pick it · tap B to enter / leave build mode · LMB place
  • The build wheel holds all eleven: barricade · wall · sandbag · spikes · fuel drum · mine · decoy · light · flame · heavy · mortar. The barricade is free; the rest stay greyed out with their price until you buy the blueprint
  • T — repair the nearest build · X — sell it
  • Fuel drums: place one, shoot it when the horde is beside it, stand well back — they chain

Waves & enemies

  • Prep — Enter starts the wave early; Settings can skip prep time altogether
  • Waves come from the bearings marked in red on the map rim
  • Chain kills fast for a streak: 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 in a row multiplies the cash they drop
  • Minimap: the 50 m around you, turned so up is always the way the camera faces (W). Zombies are the flashing red dots; red arcs on the rim are where the wave comes from
  • Tab — full map of the whole area, north-up
  • Bombers (glowing gut) sprint and detonate — shoot them before they reach your line, ideally next to other zombies
  • Leapers run on all fours and jump 5–14m onto you — sidestep the landing. Spiders — crawling zombies with six limbs — hang back and web you (slowed): kill them first
  • Demons (red, horned, from day 6 — more on a blood moon) stop and roar before they charge in a straight line: sidestep or roll when you hear it. Fire barely hurts them; bullets do
  • Spitters (bloated, olive) don't throw anything any more — they walk in and then crawl the last 15m. Easy targets, but they keep coming
  • Most of a wave is plain shamblers, and there are a lot of them. Your blade costs nothing: F one-shots shamblers, ferals, leapers and spitters through a near half-circle sweep
  • The drowned only ever come up out of the river and are fast in the water — don't fight near the banks
  • Flamethrower: the stream sticks to what it hits and fizzles in water; burning zombies light whatever they touch, and the ground keeps burning — including under you

Misc

  • Esc — pause / resume · M — mute · F11 — fullscreen
  • N — night vision (needs the helmet) · Z — laser sight · L — gun flashlight (all bought at the kiosk)
  • Settings: volume, look sensitivity, graphics quality, camera, fullscreen, skip prep time — from the title screen or Esc

Testing

  • ~ opens the dev console: "bigtex shooter" for unlimited cash, "broke" to turn it off
  • URL switches: ?debug=1 perf overlay · ?renderer=webgl WebGL2 fallback · ?sky=flat plain sky
